basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student currently majoring in Business Administration at Babson. Originally from Helsinki, Finland, I moved to the U.S. for my studies. My interests include gaming, especially Apex Legends, and attending music festivals like Primavera Sound. I dislike overly competitive environments, preferring casual gameplay and discussions. My typical online hours are evenings and weekends, balancing my part-time job at a local cafe and college life. I'm single and enjoy exploring new hobbies, particularly anything tech-related or involving outdoor activities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Most of my knowledge comes from online resources and personal experience. I discovered Apex Legends through friends and have been learning strategies through YouTube videos and Twitch streams. My education at Babson has also equipped me with analytical skills that I apply to game strategy.
